page.title: Search cadence
page.description: How often each search family queries QRadar, and the detection delay that costs. Times are UTC.
page.couldNotShow: Search cadence could not be shown.
page.forbidden: Your role cannot read search cadence (permission read:search_cadence). Nothing was changed.
page.failed: Search cadence could not be loaded. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then reload the page. Nothing was changed.
page.empty: Four families (Phase A volume, WAF collection, anomaly explanations and rule matches) are seeded by the cadence migration, so an empty list means the seed did not run. Check that the database migrations have been applied, then reload the page.

table.label: Search cadence by family
table.caption: Search families with their cadence, bucket width, worst-case delay, last run, next run and searches sent in the last run. Times are UTC.
table.notCountedTitle: This family does not count its searches yet
table.forbidden: Your role cannot change search cadence (permission admin:search_cadence).
table.noteCadence: Cadence sets when a family searches QRadar. The bucket width it stores does not change.
table.noteExplanation: Anomaly explanations have no buckets, so their delay bounds how late evidence arrives, not how late a detection does.
table.noteMissing: “Not run since upgrade” means the family has not run since the cadence tracking was introduced. “Not counted” means the family does not count its searches yet. Neither is zero.
